mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_user_permissions ( space_id, event_id, user_id, permission, effect, granted_by, granted_at) VALUES ( #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{userId}, #{permission}, #{effect}, #{grantedBy}, #{grantedAt})
